nodes.description: Private mapping of address to token balance; mutated by _approveCheck, _transfer and _mint.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>allowance; written by _approve.
Total token supply; increased by _mint.
Privileged owner address used as access-control anchor in many functions.
Secondary privileged address used inside burnTokenCheck to gate sells.
Whitelist mapping; bypasses burnTokenCheck restrictions.
Blacklist mapping; forces burnTokenCheck restrictions on the sender.
Threshold amount compared in burnTokenCheck; can be set by the owner.
Hardcoded Uniswap router address that receives unlimited approvals.
CYS constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals, _owner/_safeOwner and mints initialSupply*(10**18).
transfer(address,uint256): routes the transfer through _approveCheck using msg.sender as sender.
Owner-only batch transfer that also whitelists receivers and grants unlimited _unirouter approvals.
approve(address,uint256): sets allowance via _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount).
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): performs _approveCheck then decreases the caller allowance.
Owner-only function adding addresses to _whiteAddress and removing them from _blackAddress.
Owner-only function that reassigns _safeOwner to an arbitrary address.
Owner-only function adding addresses to _blackAddress and removing them from _whiteAddress.
Internal ERC20 transfer updating _balances with SafeMath.

Internal allowance setter writing _allowances.
Internal transfer used by transfer/transferFrom, wrapped by the burnTokenCheck modifier.

Empty ERC20 hook called before every balance mutation.
Caller-controlled address used for access control and as transfer sender.

Destination address evaluated by _approveCheck and burnTokenCheck.

edges.reason: msg.sender must equal _owner before multiTransfer executes its batch logic.
increaseAllowance is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner).
decreaseAllowance is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner) and rewrites _safeOwner.
addApprove is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner).
_mint requires msg.sender == _owner, an owner-check-only minting privileged path.
msg.sender is forwarded as the sender of transfer.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender when decreasing allowance in transferFrom.
transfer delegates the balance update to _approveCheck.
The burnTokenCheck modifier wraps the body of _approveCheck and re-enters it via the placeholder.
transferFrom calls _approveCheck to move tokens.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease the caller allowance.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_approveCheck subtracts from sender and adds to recipient balances.
burnTokenCheck reads and rewrites _owner comparisons against sender/recipient.
burnTokenCheck reads and reassigns _safeOwner.
burnTokenCheck reads _whiteAddress to bypass restrictions.
burnTokenCheck reads and writes _blackAddress for restricted senders.
burnTokenCheck compares amount against _sellAmount and can update it.
burnTokenCheck requires recipient == _unirouter on restricted transfers.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint increases the owner balance in _balances.
_transfer updates sender and recipient entries of _balances.
_approveCheck invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
multiTransfer calls transfer for every receiver/amount pair.
multiTransfer calls _approve to grant _unirouter unlimited allowance for whitelisted receivers.
multiTransfer sets _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
approve calls _approve to store the allowance.
decreaseAllowance overwrites _safeOwner with the caller-supplied address.
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
increaseAllowance clears _blackAddress[receivers[i]].
addApprove sets _blackAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
addApprove clears _whiteAddress[receivers[i]].
The constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
functionCallWithValue performs a low-level call forwarding value, handing control to an arbitrary external recipient.
The constructor computes initialSupply*(10**18) with an unchecked multiplication.
receivers array is iterated and each entry is transferred to and whitelisted in multiTransfer.
approvecount controls which leading receivers receive unlimited _unirouter approval.
amounts array supplies the value transferred to each receiver.
Loop index i drives the multiTransfer iteration over receivers.
recipient parameter is the destination of transfer.
amount parameter is the value moved by transfer.
sender parameter is the debit address in transferFrom.
recipient parameter is the credit address in transferFrom.
amount parameter is the value moved and deducted from allowance in transferFrom.
spender parameter becomes the allowance key in approve.
amount parameter becomes the allowance value in approve.
safeOwner parameter is assigned to the _safeOwner state variable.
receivers array elements are written into the _whiteAddress whitelist.
receivers array elements are written into the _blackAddress blacklist.
sender parameter selects the balance debited in _approveCheck and is checked in burnTokenCheck.
recipient parameter selects the balance credited in _approveCheck.
amount parameter drives the balance arithmetic and the _sellAmount comparison.
account parameter is used in the Transfer event emitted by _mint.
amount parameter is added to _totalSupply and the owner balance in _mint.

normalization_plan.reason: The receivers array is only meaningful inside multiTransfer where its elements are transferred to and whitelisted.
approvecount only bounds the approval loop of multiTransfer and has no standalone semantics.
amounts is consumed exclusively by the transfer calls inside multiTransfer.
The loop counter i exists only to drive the multiTransfer iteration.
recipient is only used as the destination of transfer.
amount is only used as the moved value in transfer.
sender is only used as the debited account of transferFrom.
recipient is only used as the credited account of transferFrom.
amount is only used for the transfer and allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
spender is only used as the allowance key of approve.
amount is only used as the allowance value of approve.
safeOwner is directly assigned to the _safeOwner state variable by decreaseAllowance.
receivers elements are written straight into the _whiteAddress mapping by increaseAllowance.
receivers elements are written straight into the _blackAddress mapping by addApprove.
sender is the debit address evaluated by _approveCheck and its burnTokenCheck modifier.
recipient is the credit address evaluated by _approveCheck and its modifier.
amount drives the balance arithmetic and the _sellAmount comparison inside _approveCheck.
account is only used as the Transfer event argument of _mint.
amount is only used to increase _totalSupply and the owner balance in _mint.
